title: OpenDAP component export (export/component.yaml)
description: Describes a component's export/ folder: the component as one unit, for other components and the product integration. Specification: docs/specs/component-export.md.

version.description: The tag of the producing repository this export is committed with (rules 2 and 4).

interfaces.description: The interfaces the component implements, each with its version (rule 3). Empty when it implements none.

files.description: Every exported file, relative to export/.

mechanics.description: Mass properties of the whole component as one body. Required when a mechanics file is exported.

version.description: The version of the interface implemented.

path.description: Path relative to export/, without '..' segments.

domain.description: The domain of the export contract table the file belongs to.

center_of_gravity_mm.description: Center of gravity [x, y, z] in millimetres, in the coordinate frame of the exported STEP.
